messages.text:
You're right. Order h77-o1 is marked delivered, but it has no delivery time. Without one I can't check the refund time limit. The policy sends this kind of case to a staff member (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders).

I've handed your kettle refund request to a staff member, and they will take over from here. The shop's records show the kettle was received back (refund-policy/v2/return).
